lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for choose_path hint, finish copy, finish hint, finish new_flow, finish redesign, home notification, sign_in copy, sign_in hint, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder because each has only been tested once.
For choose_path copy changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
For choose_path redesign changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
For home wait_info changes (4 tests), no clear winning effect was demonstrated, with three tests showing no clear effect and one rolled back due to a guardrail.
For adoption redesign changes (2 tests), results disagree, with one winning test and one showing no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to noise-corrected measurements across most tests.

candidates.title: Interactive Custom Pet Photo Tips Stage
candidates.change: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a stage layout with live framing tips and photo picker guidelines.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest completion rate (66.2%) and users submitted support tickets reporting failed or incorrect pet generation from bad photos.

photo_upload.text: For best generation, use clear lighting and front-facing photos of your pet.

guard.reason: Redesigns photo upload layout while keeping the photo picker functional.

candidates.score_note: Adoption loses the most users (33.8%) and support tickets confirm photo issues, but adoption redesigns have shown mixed historical results (+0.2%).

candidates.title: Interactive Waiting Room Mini Activity
candidates.change: Redesign the pet generation wait screen into an interactive companion preview stage featuring pet idle animations and progress tracking.
candidates.why: The waiting stage takes a long median time of 201s (mean 2336s), causing drop-offs while users wait passively.

guard.reason: Redesigns waiting screen while maintaining pet generation progress status.

candidates.score_note: Home stage wait times are high, but support evidence is missing for this change and redesigns require significant build effort.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Controls Quick Start Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated interactive onboarding screen right before finishing that explains basic pet interaction controls (drag, right-click menu, double-click).
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails after onboarding asking how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet.

new_desktop_controls.headline: Quick Desktop Pet Controls
new_desktop_controls.body: Learn how to interact with your new companion directly on your desktop.

components.text: Drag to move pet, right-click for quick settings, double-click to chat.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Existing Account Sync & Restore Banner
candidates.change: Add an explicit account sync hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in restores previous pets and settings.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or reset after signing in again, leading to drop-offs during sign in.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your existing account to automatically restore your saved pets and accessories.

guard.reason: Adds account sync hint copy to sign-in screen without violating pricing or fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails and sign-in drop-off; sign_in hints showed +4.0% lift in previous tests and are low cost.

candidates.title: Personality Quiz Path Discovery Flow
candidates.change: Insert a short interactive path quiz screen prior to path selection to recommend the best fit companion workflow.
candidates.why: The path choice step suffers from high mean completion time (514s), indicating user indecision during path selection.

new_path_quiz.headline: Find Your Ideal Desktop Companion
new_path_quiz.body: Answer two quick questions to discover which pet path fits your daily routine best.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Badge Reward
candidates.change: Add an official adoption badge reward component to the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing pet adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is 33.8% (lowest converting step in funnel), so introducing a reward increases completion momentum.

guard.reason: Adds an official adoption badge to the certificate screen while retaining its core function.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step targeted, but lacks support ticket evidence to confirm whether a reward addresses the core user bottleneck.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Welcome Spotlight Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a spotlight layout showcasing your companion's avatar with a direct desktop launch button.
candidates.why: Finish stage drop-off is 21.8% and support reported instances of users confused if the pet failed to show up on desktop.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: System Desktop Tray Status Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop tray notifications to alert users when background pet processing is complete.
candidates.why: Users wait a median of 201s (mean 2336s) on the waiting screen and support tickets mention app opening / pet visibility issues.

guard.reason: Enables background wait completion notification within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel and support tickets align, but home notifications previously measured negative lift (-3.3%).

candidates.title: Story Intro Card Layout Switch
candidates.change: Switch the initial story screen layout to card view and add a companion video preview asset.
candidates.why: choose_path sees a 23.8% initial drop-off rate, which can be improved with richer preview visual media.

guard.reason: Updates story intro screen layout and adds video preview component.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 23.8%, but visual/layout changes on choose_path historically yielded no clear effect (+0.6%).

candidates.title: Visual Account Direct Reconnect Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen into a two-column layout highlighting quick sign-in options alongside data backup guarantees.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were related to missing pets / account resets and 2 emails reported stalls before or on the sign in screen.

sign_in_options.text: Signing in ensures your pet memory and customization are securely saved.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

picked: Interactive Custom Pet Photo Tips Stage

decisions.title: Interactive Custom Pet Photo Tips Stage

lessons_next: Evidence remains thin for single-test categories (choose_path hint, choose_path layout, finish copy, finish hint, finish new_flow, finish redesign, home notification, home redesign, sign_in copy, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder).
For choose_path copy changes (2 tests) and choose_path redesign changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in any test.
For home wait_info changes (4 tests), no winning effect was demonstrated, with three showing no clear effect and one rolled back due to a guardrail.
For adoption redesign (3 tests) and sign_in hint (2 tests), results disagree and lack a reliable winning pattern, as each had only one winning test.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to noise-corrected measurements across most tests.
